name: Drowsing Palm
description: Press an open palm near a foe's face and send a wave of drowsing force that dulls the foe's reflexes.

name: Dream Divining
description: Read the shape of a sleeper's dream and tell from it what the sleeper plans on waking.

name: Plumage Ward
description: Fan a ward of soft dream feathers around the self that takes the weight out of a strike.

name: Slumber Tonic
description: Brew a tonic of deep sleep in an ally's mind that knits a strained body overnight.

name: Dream Snare
description: Loop a snare of dream force around a foe's mind so the foe's limbs follow the snare and not the will.

name: Mind Cloak
description: Draw a cloak over the mind that slides a hostile thought aside before it can take hold.

name: Dreamnet
description: Cast a fine net of dream force over a patch of ground that drowses every foe who walks into it.

name: Mesmeric Hold
description: Fix a foe's gaze with a slow swaying dream and hold the foe in a trance while the user acts.

name: Fathomless Probe
description: Drop a weighted line of attention into the dream layer and learn how deep a sleeper has sunk.

name: Undertow Ward
description: Hold an undertow of dream force at the body's edge that drags any strike off its line.

name: Sleepwell Mending
description: Lead an ally down to the restful depth of the dream where wounds close faster.

name: Somnambule Step
description: Take a step as a sleepwalker does so the body glides past a foe's blow without waking thought.

name: Dream Weight
description: Lower a leaden weight of dream onto a foe's limbs so every movement drags as if underwater.

name: Terror Lifting
description: Lift a clinging dread from an ally's mind and let the ally sleep clean and light.

name: Tranquil Surge
description: Pour a tranquil surge of dream force into an ally that steadies the ally's nerve in battle.

name: Plunge Below
description: Drop a foe's mind through every layer of the dream until the foe lies senseless below reach.

name: Layered Refuge
description: Wrap the user in many layers of dream force that each swallow part of an attack.

name: Paired Doze
description: Breathe a paired drowse out of both palms at once so a foe sags from two sides.

name: Duet Sight
description: See the same dream through two sleepers' minds and spot what each of them misses.

name: Mutual Veil
description: Share a veil of dream force with a partner so each guards the other's open side.

name: Bedmate Mend
description: Rest side by side with a hurt partner and share the healing sleep between the two.

name: Sibling Spark
description: Pass a spark of alertness from one linked mind to the other in the same heartbeat.

name: Pair Snare
description: Cross two strands of dream force over a foe so each pulls the foe against the other.

name: Duet Lullaby
description: Sing two interwoven lullabies with a partner that put a group of foes to sleep.

name: Twin Soothing
description: Soothe a poisoned dreamer from both minds at once so the venom is dreamed away.

name: Twin Slumber
description: Cast a twin slumber over a whole line of foes with both dreamers' force at once.

name: Mirrored Dream
description: Turn a hostile mind-strike back on its sender by holding up a dream that shows it its own face.

name: Azure Drowse
description: Wash a foe in a cool blue drowse that blurs the edges of the foe's thought.

name: Skywatch Dream
description: Rise in a dream above the field and look down to see where each foe stands.

name: Blue Veil
description: Pull a blue veil of dream force across the user that smears the user's outline.

name: Cerulean Rest
description: Lay an ally under a dream of open blue sky until the ally's strain and bruising ease.

name: Soaring Dream
description: Rise on a dream of flight so the user crosses a stretch of ground in a long glide.

name: Azure Lullaby
description: Hum a clear high lullaby that draws a foe's mind upward and out of the fight.

name: Skyfall Slumber
description: Let a great sleep fall like rain from a clear sky upon every foe in the dreamer's sight.

name: Azure Reverie
description: Leave a lingering blue reverie on the ground that lulls any foe who steps into it.

name: Breeze Drowse
description: Send a drowsing breeze across a foe's face that slows the foe's eyes and hands.

name: Airborne Murmur
description: Hear on the wind the whisper of every sleeper in the camp and know who dreams of harm.

name: Oath Veil
description: Spread a veil of dream force sworn to cover a sleeping friend against any harm.

name: Fresh Sleep
description: Breathe a fresh clean sleep into an ally whose body is spent so the ally rises restored.

name: Wind Dream
description: Ride a dream of wind to cover ground in a swift light drift.

name: Bearing Lull
description: Take a bearing on a foe's mind and lull it steadily toward sleep along that line.

name: Vowed Stillness
description: Swear a calm over a dread-stricken ally and drive the dread out of the ally's dreams.

name: Oathbound Slumber
description: Bind a foe to sleep on the dreamer's oath so the slumber holds until the oath is released.

name: Gust Snare
description: Leave a gust of drowsing air on the ground that trips a foe's mind as the foe passes.

name: Quiet Doze
description: Hush a foe's senses with a quiet doze that makes the foe miss the sound of the next step.

name: Hushed Sense
description: Still the user's own thoughts to the lowest hush and hear the dreams of those near.

name: Silent Veil
description: Wrap the user in a silent veil of dream force that soaks up the noise and weight of a blow.

name: Breathing Rest
description: Guide an ally through the deep slow breaths of sleep until its body takes the repair.

name: Steady Sleep
description: Give a worn ally a short steady sleep that returns clear strength on waking.

name: Hushed Bind
description: Bind a foe in a hush so complete that the foe cannot call out or move.

name: Sleep Oath
description: Speak a low oath of sleep over a foe and hold the foe to it with soft pressure.

name: Dread Unbinding
description: Untie the knot of dread that keeps an ally from sleeping and let the ally rest.

name: Unbroken Silence
description: Lay an unbroken silence over a field of foes so every one of them slows to a stupor.

name: Oathkeeper's Rest
description: Hold a whole company of weary allies in a guarded rest until each wakes mended.
